chunks: "Whoever shaves his head or plucks his underarm hair out of forgetfulness, inadvertence, or ignorance, then there is nothing upon him."
ai.seo_question: Is there any penalty for a muhrim who shaves or removes hair out of forgetfulness or ignorance?
ai.summary: This report states a legal ruling that no liability or penalty applies to one who shaves the head or plucks underarm hair while forgetful, inattentive, or unaware. It reflects the juristic principle that acts done without deliberate intent may not incur blame in the state of ihram.
